title: Kafka 4.x consumer protocol enabled alongside configs it disables
expected_feedback: Standard: three of these five lines are dead config. Under group.protocol=consumer (KIP-848, GA in 4.0) partition.assignment.strategy, session.timeout.ms and heartbeat.interval.ms are no longer usable, along with enforceRebalance(). The team believes it has configured cooperative rebalancing and tuned its failure detection; in reality the server decides both. Assignment is chosen by the broker's group.consumer.assignors (uniform by default — the equivalent of CooperativeStickyAssignor); a client selects a different one with group.remote.assignor. Heartbeat and session timeout are now the broker configs group.consumer.heartbeat.interval.ms and group.consumer.session.timeout.ms, so tuning them is no longer a change the application team can make alone. max.poll.interval.ms is still a client config and still applies. Also confirm no custom client-side assignor is in use — those are not supported under the new protocol (KAFKA-18327).
violated_rule: group.protocol recorded and configuration matched to it
